title: Not as great as I expected!
text: Not as great as I expected!. At first I was very pleased with this frame; it had the hanging sawtooth already attached and I liked the color. However the one (major) flaw is the acrylic cover. It is flimsy and mine had scratches on it (even though there was film wrap attached) so there was no way anything I framed would be acceptable. Some advice for would-be DYI framers -- like so many things, it is not as easy as it looks. If you can afford to have your precious photos or whatever professionally framed -- do it!  I am not going to bother returning the frame but will chalk it up as a learning experience!
